mapper.select: SELECT t.reading_protocol,p.plan_hash,p.plan_json FROM ai_tasks t LEFT JOIN task_content_read_plans p ON p.task_id=t.id WHERE t.id=#{args[0]}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_tasks SET reading_protocol=#{args[1]} WHERE id=#{args[0]} AND reading_protocol IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT policy_hash,policy_json FROM task_content_policies WHERE task_id=#{args[0]}
SELECT CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(source_json,'$.policy.resultBytes')) AS UNSIGNED) AS result_bytes FROM task_content_runs WHERE task_id=#{args[0]} AND source_hash IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_content_nodes(task_id,node_id,stage,input_hash,output_hash,output_json,status,completed_at) VALUES (#{row[0]},#{row[1]},'extract',#{row[2]},#{row[3]},#{row[4]},'COMPLETED',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE output_hash=VALUES(output_hash),output_json=VALUES(output_json),status='COMPLETED',completed_at=COALESCE(completed_at,VALUES(completed_at))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM task_content_nodes WHERE task_id=#{args[0]} AND node_id=#{args[1]}
SELECT * FROM task_content_nodes WHERE task_id=#{args[0]} ORDER BY node_id
SELECT * FROM task_content_nodes WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND node_id IN #{nodeId}
SELECT node_id FROM task_content_nodes WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND status='COMPLETED' AND node_id IN #{nodeId}
mapper.update: UPDATE task_content_nodes SET output_hash=#{args[0]},output_json=#{args[1]},status='COMPLETED',completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE task_id=#{args[2]} AND node_id=#{args[3]} AND input_hash=#{args[4]} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE task_content_runs SET plan_hash=#{args[0]},plan_json=#{args[1]} WHERE task_id=#{args[2]} AND plan_hash IS NULL
UPDATE ai_tasks SET state_version=state_version+1 WHERE id=#{args[0]}
UPDATE task_step_progress SET status='SUCCEEDED',completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),error_code=NULL WHERE task_id=#{args[0]} AND step_id=#{args[1]} AND status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_document_coverage(task_id,document_id,document_version,processing_revision,section_id,completed_pages,read_start,read_end,remaining_start,remaining_end,complete,count_source) VALUES(#{args[0]},#{args[1]},#{args[2]},#{args[3]},'1',#{args[4]},0,#{args[5]},#{args[5]},#{args[5]},TRUE,'ESTIMATED_UTF8_BYTES') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE completed_pages=VALUES(completed_pages),read_end=VALUES(read_end),remaining_start=VALUES(remaining_start),remaining_end=VALUES(remaining_end),complete=TRUE
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM task_content_packages WHERE task_id=#{args[0]} ORDER BY package_id
SELECT * FROM task_content_packages WHERE task_id=#{args[0]} AND package_id=#{args[1]}
SELECT * FROM task_content_packages WHERE task_id=#{args[0]} ORDER BY package_id LIMIT #{args[2]} OFFSET #{args[1]}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS package_count FROM task_content_packages WHERE task_id=#{args[0]}
mapper.update: UPDATE task_content_packages SET status='RUNNING',attempts=attempts+1,error_code=NULL WHERE task_id=#{args[0]} AND package_id=#{args[1]} AND status IN ('PENDING','FAILED','RUNNING')
UPDATE task_content_packages SET status='ACCEPTED',result_hash=#{args[2]},completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE task_id=#{args[0]} AND package_id=#{args[1]} AND status='RUNNING'
UPDATE task_content_packages SET status='FAILED',error_code=#{args[2]} WHERE task_id=#{args[0]} AND package_id=#{args[1]} AND status='RUNNING'
UPDATE task_content_packages SET status='REPLACED' WHERE task_id=#{args[0]} AND package_id=#{args[1]} AND status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','FAILED')
